Claim 1 (Currently Amended): A method, comprising: inputting database constructs generated by a database optimizer as an input to a trained machine-learning algorithm; obtaining a database operation predictor __from the trained machine-learning algorithm__ as an output; modifying at least one of the database constructs based on the database operation predictor producing a modified database construct; and processing a database operation with the __original__ database constructs and the modified database construct.

Claim 10 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 1, further comprising, storing the database operation predictor in database statistics associated with the database operation and the __original__ database constructs.

Claim 12 (Currently Amended): A method comprising: training a machine-learning algorithm with database constructs produced by a database optimizer; receiving query execution plans for a query from the database optimizer with a least cost query execution plan identified by the database optimizer for the query; providing the query execution plans as input to the machine-learning algorithm; obtaining as an output a predicted execution time for the query based on the least cost query execution plan; and modifying one of: the least cost query execution plan for the query, a scheduled execution time for the query, and resources that are used to execute the query based on the predicted execution time and __the optimally modified characteristics of the least cost query execution plan__.

Claim 15 (Cancelled) 

Claim 18 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 12, wherein modifying further includes changing an execution resource of the least cost query execution plan based on the predicted query execution time and a current performance associated with the __execution resources employed__.
